items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: he'd say Cozy, I'm still in practice, you know

ctx.x: Trumpet player. Later on in years, because he hadn't played in a while, he was, Ray Robinson, the fighter, he was Ray Robinson's manager, and June Clark was a very dear friend of all the guys, all the musicians, and he was a good trumpet player. Something I think he was, he had tuberculosis, the doctor ordered him off his horn for a while, but he always used to walk around with his mouthpiece in his watch pocket in his pants and always said, when he'd see you, he'd say Cozy, I'm still in practice, you know, and…
Let's see, when did he.....in '63 it says.
